_comment: Default dry-run config list. Every entry with a `capture` runs entirely against captures/*.pcapng already in the repo -- no hardware, no Ledset, no transmission. This is `python -m tools.oracle.harness run`'s default input.

configs.name: 01-black
configs.notes: 2026-08-06 capture rig, one controller. Baseline: all-zero body.

configs.name: 02-white
configs.notes: Expect a small number of tolerated frames: Ledset's documented loop-boundary blanks and torn frame.

configs.name: 03-red
configs.notes: Colour-order check -- a wrong BGR/RGB assumption fails every frame, not just a few.

configs.name: 06-halves
configs.notes: Left half white, right half black. The first spatial check -- a solid colour cannot detect a permutation, this can (coarsely: at port granularity).

configs.name: 20-ours-white
configs.notes: Our own Python sender's capture, not Ledset's -- the harness validates both a vendor and our own transmission the same way.

configs.name: 8x8_4P_10x5-acceptance-gradient24
configs.notes: The acceptance geometry: three controllers, partial last controller. No capture exists yet -- blocked on the attended Player-page session. See docs/ORACLE_HARNESS.md 'Blocked on the attended session', item 1. Included here (with capture=null) so the report shows this gap as a row, not a silent absence.
